# The DRIPBaR Colleyville

> The DRIPBaR Colleyville is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in Colleyville, Texas. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+ infusions, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, and wellness therapies, delivered by a licensed clinical team under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 5509 Colleyville Blvd, Ste 120, Colleyville, TX 76034
- Phone (call or text): (469) 942-5862
- Hours: Monday: 11 AM to 7 PM; Tuesday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Wednesday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday to Sunday: 12 PM to 5 PM
- Booking: https://thedripbarcolleyville.com/booking (online, 24/7) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $199 regular and $159 for members. Some drips (100% Hydration, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, add-on drips) are priced separately.
- New guest offer: New guests can try any Lifestyle drip on their first visit for the member price of $159 (regularly $199). A $35 yearly consultation fee applies at the first visit.
- All IV drips and quick shots are administered by registered nurses under physician oversight. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, and NAD+ planning.
